messages.subject: Project Quartz - SPA v3 (cap at 10%)
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Attached is v3 (redline against v2). As agreed we've taken the Sellers' liability cap to 10% of consideration (£3,875,000), retained the 18-month general / 7-year tax periods, and added a fraud/wilful-concealment carve-out. This is on the basis the Northstar consent position and the HMRC R&D enquiry are disclosed - your client has confirmed both will be.

If this works we'll move to engrossment and target completion on 13 February.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
